defs.def: loved by or important to sb 亲爱的；宝贵的；珍视的

ex.s: I'm afraid I won't be able to meet you this time, but you'll always be my dear friend.
ex.t: 恐怕这次我没法见你了，但你永远是我亲爱的朋友。

ex.s: Dear Friends, We are writing this letter to call on everyone to take part in the Clear Your Plate campaign.
ex.t: 亲爱的朋友们，我们写这封信是为了呼吁所有人参加Clear Your Plate活动。

defs.def: （用于信函抬头的名字或头衔前）亲爱的

ex.s: Dear Editor, 1 We have eaten out for the Spring Festival family dinner for the last three years, and we have enjoyed it no less than eating at home.
ex.t: 尊敬的编辑：1 过去三年我们都在外面吃春节家庭聚餐，我们享受的程度不亚于在家吃。

ex.s: Wang Peng, software engineer ＜/R＞ Dear Editor, 1 For this year's Spring Festival family dinner, my son has booked a table at the best restaurant in town, but I'm a bit unhappy about it.
ex.t: 王鹏，软件工程师 ＜/R＞ 亲爱的编辑，1 今年的春节年夜饭，我儿子已经在城里最好的餐厅订了位，但我对此有点不高兴。

ex.s: She’d just look up at the right time, long enough to answer-in character - “The better to eat you with, my dear,” and go back to her place in the magazine article.
ex.t: 她只是在恰当的时候抬起头——足够长的时间——用角色的语气回答："这样我就能更好地吃掉你了，亲爱的，"然后回到她的杂志文章那里去。

defs.def: expensive; costing a lot of money 昂贵；价格高
a kind person 仁慈的人；可爱的人
（对较年轻的人或孩子说话时用）亲爱的，乖乖
